subject: Governance & security clearance: next steps and owner map
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@cloudhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: security checklist and stakeholders (CloudHealth / Redwood)

Karthik — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and asks so my procurement and security teams can move forward:

- Decision criteria: cost per 1k tokens, end-to-end encryption, audit logging (7+ years preferred), and data deletion SLA for PII.
- Key stakeholders: Emma Clarke (data platform lead, owner of technical eval), Raj Patel (security), Lori James (procurement/econ buyer is still TBD but Lori coordinates contract cadence).
- Evidence requested: SOC 2 Type II report or summary, recent penetration test executive summary, details on where audit logs are held and retention controls, and a short write-up on data retention/deletion flow for customer-managed datasets.

Would it be possible to get a compact bundle of those items (1 pager SOC2 summary, pen-test executive note, and a short FAQ on retention) by EOD Thursday? Procurement is planning a commercial review the following week. Also, please include a single point of contact at Redwood for security/procurement follow-ups.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Clarke
Head of Data Platform
CloudHealth Analytics

Subject: Re: Follow-up: security checklist and stakeholders (CloudHealth / Redwood)

Emma — really appreciate the clear recap. Short answers and next steps from our side: 

1) Owners: I will be the primary contact for the commercial path and coordinate evidence delivery. Ben will handle the security technical details and Marissa will support procurement/commercial items.
2) Evidence pack: we can deliver a consolidated packet with the following by Thursday EOD (your timezone):
   - Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (1 page exec summary + list of controls)
   - redwood-pen-test-highlevel.txt (pen test scope + exec findings; redacted)
   - data-retention-and-deletion-FAQ.docx (answers re: retention windows, deletion flow, KMS keys)
3) Audit logs: we will include a short note that logs are retained in encrypted blob storage in us-west-2 by default; configurable retention up to 7 years; can provide filtering/exports for audit.
4) Contract cadence: can we confirm whether procurement needs a master services agreement or a shorter SOW-first approach? That will affect timelines; if they want MSA review, allow two weeks typical for review.

Action items (high level):
- Ben: assemble SOC2 summary and pen-test exec summary (due Thu EOD)
- Marissa: prepare a commercial FAQ and draft SOW / pricing note (due Fri EOD)
- Karthik: circulate a single doc and create a HubSpot ticket linking to the folder + confirm procurement contact (Lori)

I'll attach the evidence bundle to the next email. Let me know if Lori should be looped earlier.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, redwood-pen-test-highlevel.txt, data-retention-and-deletion-FAQ.docx
From: Lori James <lori.james@cloudhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security checklist and stakeholders (CloudHealth / Redwood)

Thanks — Lori here (procurement). Quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Procurement preference: we typically start with a short SOW for a POC (30–60 days) and then move to an MSA for enterprise scale.
- Commercial timeline: if we receive the evidence bundle by Thursday, legal will start a light review the following Monday and aim to have comments back within 10 business days.
- Pricing/discounts: please include your standard POC pricing and any seat/commit discounts in the SOW.

If you can flag any non-standard terms up front (data residency, indemnity caps), that helps us prioritize legal review.

Best,
Lori
Sr. Sourcing Manager (Procurement)
CloudHealth Analytics

- SOC2 summary (Ben) — check for any customer-identifiable detail; include date of latest assessment and link to SIG compliance note.

Tentative send to CloudHealth: Thu EOD (Pacific). If anything blocks, escalate to me directly.
